jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions. This role will work closely with engineering, product, design, and QA teams to build reliable applications and services that meet business and user needs.

About the Role

The ideal candidate has strong full-stack development experience, a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.

Onsite Role in Dallas, Texas.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full-stack features using Node.js, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and HTML/CSS.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript.
Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.
Write clean, efficient, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code.
Participate in code reviews and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.
Research technical issues, identify root causes, and develop clear and effective solutions.
Contribute to technical design discussions and engineering best practices.
Stay current with evolving technologies, tools, and software development practices.
Work effectively within Agile/Scrum development environments.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant software engineering experience.
2+ years of experience with PostgreSQL and messaging systems such as Kafka.
Strong knowledge of software development principles, programming methodologies, and engineering best practices.
Proficiency with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, HTML/CSS, and Bash.
Experience working with UI/UX teams to implement technical specifications across modern browsers.
Demonstrated experience developing microservices, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and JSON-based services.
Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, and SQL.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Experience participating in code reviews and providing technical guidance or mentorship.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Working knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with unit testing and end-to-end testing frameworks.

Preferred Skills

Experience designing and supporting distributed or microservices-based systems.
Experience working with cloud-native application architectures.
Familiarity with modern CI/CD and automated testing practices.
Experience troubleshooting complex production or performance issues.

Pay range and compensation package

70K to 75K Per Year

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
About ThredUp

ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry.

Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022.

How You Will Make An Impact

A generation of shoppers is starting to find what they want by asking an AI agent instead of browsing a website. The marketplaces those agents can read, understand, and buy from will win that traffic; the ones they can't won't get surfaced at all. As our first Senior Software Engineer for Agentic Commerce, you'll build the layer that makes 4 million unique secondhand items discoverable and transactable by AI shopping agents, and own how ThredUp shows up when someone asks an agent to find them a dress for a wedding.

This is early, open territory. The standards are young, customer behaviors are still forming, and there's no established playbook to follow. You'll partner closely with engineering and product leadership to give the space shape — working out what's worth building, making the architectural decisions together, and getting real functionality in front of customers to learn from. For the first stretch you'll be the primary engineer on this work, with broad ownership of how it comes together. You'll report to our Senior Director of Engineering.

In This Role You'll Get To

Design and build the agentic-commerce layer end to end — from exposing our catalog, pricing, and inventory to AI shopping agents through cart, checkout, and order handoff — defining the integration surface rather than inheriting one.
Own how ThredUp gets discovered and surfaced by LLM-driven shopping agents, including the structured data that makes 4M+ unique, single-SKU items legible to machines.
Prototype quickly against real agent platforms, then harden what proves out into production-grade services — working across the stack, wherever the problem lives.
Use AI tools and agentic workflows as a core part of how you build, setting the bar for what AI-native engineering looks like at ThredUp.
Partner with engineering, product, and executive leadership to turn an undefined space into a roadmap, carry it from idea to shipped, and let real customer usage drive what comes next.
Our stack: Ruby on Rails, Java/JVM, MySQL, Kafka, Redis, Sidekiq, OpenSearch, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform. Apollo GraphQL API gateway. React, PWA, native iOS and Android. No prior experience with any particular piece required.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of software engineering experience, owning systems end to end from ambiguous problem to production.
Fluent daily use of LLMs and agentic coding tools, with strong instincts for where AI output needs human judgment.
Experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, and an understanding of how model behavior shapes product experience.
Strong API and integration design skills, for interfaces consumed by other systems rather than by people.
Depth in backend engineering with the range to work across the stack. Design judgment matters more here than which languages you've used.
Genuine curiosity about a space that changes monthly — new protocols, new tooling, new model capabilities — and the habit of keeping up with it.
Comfort working from a blank page without a surrounding team to make progress.
The judgment to scope a problem, put a plan behind it, and drive it to shipped rather than exploring indefinitely.
Clear communication with engineers and non-technical executives alike.
Familiarity with the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), MCP, or other emerging agentic-commerce standards is a plus.
E-commerce or marketplace experience is a plus.
Experience having built something from zero, whether at a startup or inside a larger company is a plus.

Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock, ThredUp employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, as well as a discount when purchasing ThredUp stock if voluntarily participating in ThredUp's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Subject to eligibility requirements, you'll also receive other benefits: Comprehensive medical & dental coverage, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

What We Offer

4-day work week, with most Fridays off
Competitive salary (we leverage market data)
Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock and are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards
Employee stock purchase plan
Flexible PTO (take the time you need) + 13 company holidays
Paid Sabbatical after 3 years of full time employment
Generous paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers
Medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance offered
We live by our Core Values of Transparency, SpeakingUP, Thinking Big, Infinite Learning, Influencing Outcomes & Seeking the Truth

We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team

At ThredUp, our mission has been built on extending the lives of millions of unique clothing items. Much like our inventory, we are proud to have fostered a workplace that is one-of-a-kind. As a company focused on diversity, inclusion and belonging, we are committed to ensuring our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work every day. A unique perspective is critical to solving complex problems and inspiring a new generation to think secondhand first. Be you.

If you are a candidate with a disability and have a reasonable accommodation request for the job application process, please email disabilitysupport@ThredUp.com the specific details of your disability related accommodation request. This email address is reserved for candidates with disabilities only. General application inquiries will not receive a response.

jobs.title: Data Integration Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Solve Data Challenges as our Next Data Integration Software Engineer!

Are you ready to optimize global supply chain workflows through advanced data engineering and smart integrations? Join Trimble Transportation to lead high-impact technical solutions, analyze complex TMS databases, and leverage automation and AI to revolutionize how transportation networks move freight!

About Us

Trimble Transportation is transforming the global supply chain through intelligent, connected technology and workflows that are rooted in industry standard commercial maps and data. At the intersection of the physical and digital worlds, Trimble Transportation offers SaaS, web, mobile and installed solutions that improve efficiency, promote safety, optimize utilization, and enable collaboration. From planning to delivery, we provide cutting edge procurement, transportation management, mapping, routing, dispatch, navigation, location, fleet management, ELD compliance and asset maintenance solutions. For more information, visit: transportation.trimble.com.

What Makes This Role Great

In this role, you will be at the heart of technical innovation for enterprise fleet and transportation systems, taking key ownership of complex custom integrations, database optimization, and data analysis within TMWSuite while driving forward-thinking AI and automation capabilities.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

Spearhead advanced technical support and issue resolution for TMWSuite applications, database architecture, and integration workflows.
Engineer, maintain, and troubleshoot pre-process and post-process scripts to power seamless customer-specific integrations.
Utilize expert SQL and relational database analysis to investigate system behaviors, conduct root-cause analysis, and ensure data integrity.
Champion an AI-forward approach by identifying and implementing opportunities to leverage automation and emerging technologies for enhanced solution delivery.

Essential Skills & Experience

Strong working knowledge of Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ideally TMWSuite, including functional workflows and underlying structures.
Proficient SQL skills with deep capability in querying, analyzing, and troubleshooting complex relational databases.
Solid background in scripting concepts with hands-on ability to write, modify, and debug pre/post-process scripts.
Proven expertise troubleshooting enterprise application issues, performing root-cause analysis, and managing data integration flows.

Bonus Points For

Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, or automated scripting tools to technical troubleshooting and data processes.
Prior experience collaborating across cross-functional engineering, product, and support teams to resolve complex customer issues.

Logistics

Location
: US - Remote

Travel Requirement
: Minimal / As Needed

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact
. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

Data Integration Engineer, Software Engineer, TMWSuite, SQL, Relational Databases, TMS, Pre-Process Scripting, Post-Process Scripting, Data Analysis, System Integration, Supply Chain Technology, Transportation Management Systems

This compensation range is based on a full time schedule. Trimble reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law.

Trimble offers comprehensive core benefits that include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Time off plans and retirement plans. Most of our businesses also offer tax savings plans for health, dependent care and commuter expenses as well as Paid Parental Leave and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. If this position is identified above as commission- or bonus-eligible, the terms of the commission plan or discretionary bonus plan for which you are eligible will be provided following the employee start date.

Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer- Calculation Engines (NY)
jobs.description:
Our FinTech client is looking for a Staff Backend Software Engineer to join the team responsible for the core calculation infrastructure that powers our entire platform.This is not a typical backend role. This team owns the high-performance calculation engines, distributed services, caching layers, communication protocols, and platform infrastructure that sit at the heart of our product. More than 95% of platform activity flows through these systems, making this one of the most technically challenging and impactful engineering teams in the organization.If you're passionate about building large-scale distributed systems, solving complex performance and memory challenges, and developing platforms that process massive amounts of data with high reliability and throughput, this role offers the opportunity to work on critical infrastructure at enterprise scale. They are particularly interested in engineers with deep Java expertise, though experienced C++ and Python developers with strong distributed systems backgrounds will also be considered.

The pay range for this role is 170-230k base plus bonus and equity. The company has a hybrid work policy (2-3 days a week in their New York City office). Unfortunately, the company cannot sponsor at this time, so only Green Card Holders and US Citizens will be considered. If you meet the required qualifications and are interested in this role, please apply today.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and scale the distributed calculation engines that power our analytics and reporting platform.
Build high-performance backend services that process and calculate across massive datasets in real time and at scale.
Architect and implement distributed microservices that prioritize performance, resiliency, scalability, and operational excellence.
Solve complex challenges involving memory management, concurrency, caching, data distribution, and inter-service communication.
Drive the evolution of our platform toward a modern cloud-native architecture.
Optimize critical systems for throughput, latency, resource utilization, and reliability.
Partner with engineers across platform, infrastructure, data, and product teams to develop scalable technical solutions.
Lead technical design and architectural decision-making for large-scale initiatives.
Improve tooling, observability, automation, CI/CD processes, and developer productivity across the organization.
Evaluate and implement technologies that support the next generation of platform growth and scale.

Required Qualifications:

8+ years of experience building large-scale backend systems in production environments.
Strong professional software development experience in Java, with a deep understanding of object-oriented design and engineering best practices.
Experience designing and operating distributed systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of system performance, concurrency, memory utilization, and application optimization.
Experience building platforms or applications that process significant volumes of data.
Deep knowledge of microservices architecture and service-to-service communication patterns.
Experience developing and operating software in Linux-based environments.
Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and a passion for tackling complex engineering challenges.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction across teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

Expertise in Java performance tuning, JVM internals, garbage collection, and memory optimization.
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
Experience with distributed caching technologies, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures.
Experience working with high-throughput, low-latency applications.
Experience with large-scale data processing platforms and data-intensive systems.
Familiarity with Python or C++ in production environments.
Experience with SQL, distributed databases, key-value stores, and time-series data technologies.
Exposure to cloud-native architectures and modern observability practices.
Financial Services or FinTech experience is a plus but not required.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce
new_jobs.description:
About ThredUp

ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry.

Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022.

How You Will Make An Impact

A generation of shoppers is starting to find what they want by asking an AI agent instead of browsing a website. The marketplaces those agents can read, understand, and buy from will win that traffic; the ones they can't won't get surfaced at all. As our first Senior Software Engineer for Agentic Commerce, you'll build the layer that makes 4 million unique secondhand items discoverable and transactable by AI shopping agents, and own how ThredUp shows up when someone asks an agent to find them a dress for a wedding.

This is early, open territory. The standards are young, customer behaviors are still forming, and there's no established playbook to follow. You'll partner closely with engineering and product leadership to give the space shape — working out what's worth building, making the architectural decisions together, and getting real functionality in front of customers to learn from. For the first stretch you'll be the primary engineer on this work, with broad ownership of how it comes together. You'll report to our Senior Director of Engineering.

In This Role You'll Get To

Design and build the agentic-commerce layer end to end — from exposing our catalog, pricing, and inventory to AI shopping agents through cart, checkout, and order handoff — defining the integration surface rather than inheriting one.
Own how ThredUp gets discovered and surfaced by LLM-driven shopping agents, including the structured data that makes 4M+ unique, single-SKU items legible to machines.
Prototype quickly against real agent platforms, then harden what proves out into production-grade services — working across the stack, wherever the problem lives.
Use AI tools and agentic workflows as a core part of how you build, setting the bar for what AI-native engineering looks like at ThredUp.
Partner with engineering, product, and executive leadership to turn an undefined space into a roadmap, carry it from idea to shipped, and let real customer usage drive what comes next.
Our stack: Ruby on Rails, Java/JVM, MySQL, Kafka, Redis, Sidekiq, OpenSearch, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform. Apollo GraphQL API gateway. React, PWA, native iOS and Android. No prior experience with any particular piece required.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of software engineering experience, owning systems end to end from ambiguous problem to production.
Fluent daily use of LLMs and agentic coding tools, with strong instincts for where AI output needs human judgment.
Experience building or deploying systems powered by LLMs, and an understanding of how model behavior shapes product experience.
Strong API and integration design skills, for interfaces consumed by other systems rather than by people.
Depth in backend engineering with the range to work across the stack. Design judgment matters more here than which languages you've used.
Genuine curiosity about a space that changes monthly — new protocols, new tooling, new model capabilities — and the habit of keeping up with it.
Comfort working from a blank page without a surrounding team to make progress.
The judgment to scope a problem, put a plan behind it, and drive it to shipped rather than exploring indefinitely.
Clear communication with engineers and non-technical executives alike.
Familiarity with the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), MCP, or other emerging agentic-commerce standards is a plus.
E-commerce or marketplace experience is a plus.
Experience having built something from zero, whether at a startup or inside a larger company is a plus.

Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock, ThredUp employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, as well as a discount when purchasing ThredUp stock if voluntarily participating in ThredUp's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Subject to eligibility requirements, you'll also receive other benefits: Comprehensive medical & dental coverage, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

What We Offer

4-day work week, with most Fridays off
Competitive salary (we leverage market data)
Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock and are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards
Employee stock purchase plan
Flexible PTO (take the time you need) + 13 company holidays
Paid Sabbatical after 3 years of full time employment
Generous paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers
Medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance offered
We live by our Core Values of Transparency, SpeakingUP, Thinking Big, Infinite Learning, Influencing Outcomes & Seeking the Truth

We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team

At ThredUp, our mission has been built on extending the lives of millions of unique clothing items. Much like our inventory, we are proud to have fostered a workplace that is one-of-a-kind. As a company focused on diversity, inclusion and belonging, we are committed to ensuring our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work every day. A unique perspective is critical to solving complex problems and inspiring a new generation to think secondhand first. Be you.

If you are a candidate with a disability and have a reasonable accommodation request for the job application process, please email disabilitysupport@ThredUp.com the specific details of your disability related accommodation request. Solve Data Challenges as our Next Data Integration Software Engineer!

Are you ready to optimize global supply chain workflows through advanced data engineering and smart integrations? Join Trimble Transportation to lead high-impact technical solutions, analyze complex TMS databases, and leverage automation and AI to revolutionize how transportation networks move freight!

About Us

Trimble Transportation is transforming the global supply chain through intelligent, connected technology and workflows that are rooted in industry standard commercial maps and data. At the intersection of the physical and digital worlds, Trimble Transportation offers SaaS, web, mobile and installed solutions that improve efficiency, promote safety, optimize utilization, and enable collaboration. From planning to delivery, we provide cutting edge procurement, transportation management, mapping, routing, dispatch, navigation, location, fleet management, ELD compliance and asset maintenance solutions. For more information, visit: transportation.trimble.com.

What Makes This Role Great

In this role, you will be at the heart of technical innovation for enterprise fleet and transportation systems, taking key ownership of complex custom integrations, database optimization, and data analysis within TMWSuite while driving forward-thinking AI and automation capabilities.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

Spearhead advanced technical support and issue resolution for TMWSuite applications, database architecture, and integration workflows.
Engineer, maintain, and troubleshoot pre-process and post-process scripts to power seamless customer-specific integrations.
Utilize expert SQL and relational database analysis to investigate system behaviors, conduct root-cause analysis, and ensure data integrity.
Champion an AI-forward approach by identifying and implementing opportunities to leverage automation and emerging technologies for enhanced solution delivery.

Essential Skills & Experience

Strong working knowledge of Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ideally TMWSuite, including functional workflows and underlying structures.
Proficient SQL skills with deep capability in querying, analyzing, and troubleshooting complex relational databases.
Solid background in scripting concepts with hands-on ability to write, modify, and debug pre/post-process scripts.
Proven expertise troubleshooting enterprise application issues, performing root-cause analysis, and managing data integration flows.

Bonus Points For

Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, or automated scripting tools to technical troubleshooting and data processes.
Prior experience collaborating across cross-functional engineering, product, and support teams to resolve complex customer issues.

Logistics

Location
: US - Remote

Travel Requirement
: Minimal / As Needed

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact
. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

new_jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer- Calculation Engines (NY)
new_jobs.description:
Our FinTech client is looking for a Staff Backend Software Engineer to join the team responsible for the core calculation infrastructure that powers our entire platform.This is not a typical backend role. This team owns the high-performance calculation engines, distributed services, caching layers, communication protocols, and platform infrastructure that sit at the heart of our product. More than 95% of platform activity flows through these systems, making this one of the most technically challenging and impactful engineering teams in the organization.If you're passionate about building large-scale distributed systems, solving complex performance and memory challenges, and developing platforms that process massive amounts of data with high reliability and throughput, this role offers the opportunity to work on critical infrastructure at enterprise scale. They are particularly interested in engineers with deep Java expertise, though experienced C++ and Python developers with strong distributed systems backgrounds will also be considered.

The pay range for this role is 170-230k base plus bonus and equity. The company has a hybrid work policy (2-3 days a week in their New York City office). Unfortunately, the company cannot sponsor at this time, so only Green Card Holders and US Citizens will be considered. If you meet the required qualifications and are interested in this role, please apply today.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and scale the distributed calculation engines that power our analytics and reporting platform.
Build high-performance backend services that process and calculate across massive datasets in real time and at scale.
Architect and implement distributed microservices that prioritize performance, resiliency, scalability, and operational excellence.
Solve complex challenges involving memory management, concurrency, caching, data distribution, and inter-service communication.
Drive the evolution of our platform toward a modern cloud-native architecture.
Optimize critical systems for throughput, latency, resource utilization, and reliability.
Partner with engineers across platform, infrastructure, data, and product teams to develop scalable technical solutions.
Lead technical design and architectural decision-making for large-scale initiatives.
Improve tooling, observability, automation, CI/CD processes, and developer productivity across the organization.
Evaluate and implement technologies that support the next generation of platform growth and scale.

Required Qualifications:

8+ years of experience building large-scale backend systems in production environments.
Strong professional software development experience in Java, with a deep understanding of object-oriented design and engineering best practices.
Experience designing and operating distributed systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of system performance, concurrency, memory utilization, and application optimization.
Experience building platforms or applications that process significant volumes of data.
Deep knowledge of microservices architecture and service-to-service communication patterns.
Experience developing and operating software in Linux-based environments.
Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and a passion for tackling complex engineering challenges.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction across teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

Expertise in Java performance tuning, JVM internals, garbage collection, and memory optimization.
Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
Experience with distributed caching technologies, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures.
Experience working with high-throughput, low-latency applications.
Experience with large-scale data processing platforms and data-intensive systems.
Familiarity with Python or C++ in production environments.
Experience with SQL, distributed databases, key-value stores, and time-series data technologies.
Exposure to cloud-native architectures and modern observability practices.
Financial Services or FinTech experience is a plus but not required.
